stories.title: Washtenaw residents file recall bids against seven officials over data centers
stories.dek: A local opponent has turned in signatures to recall seven elected officials in the Ann Arbor area. The effort stems from fights over proposed data-center projects and their effects on power, water and taxes. Voters 30 miles away will watch whether the recalls reach the ballot and shift local control.
stories.source_title: Data center opponent submits recall signatures targeting 7 elected officials near Ann Arbor - MLive.com

stories.title: DTE says data centers key to holding down Michigan power rates
stories.dek: DTE Energy tied future rate stability to landing large data-center loads in its latest filing. The utility's pipeline of big projects has stayed steady even as power demand forecasts rise. Michigan households could see the impact in bills if those campuses come online or stall.
stories.source_title: DTE ties rate stability to data center projects as large-load pipeline remains steady - Utility Dive

stories.title: U.S. Rep. Scholten Introduces Federal Bills Requiring Data Center Water, Energy Reporting and Efficiency Standards
stories.dek: The Grand Rapids Democrat's legislation would mandate annual surveys of data center operators' resource use and update Defense Department cooling requirements to protect water supplies amid Michigan projects.

stories.title: Poll: 55% of Michigan primary voters oppose nearby data centers
stories.dek: Opposition hits 63% among likely Democratic primary voters as candidates clash over who pays higher electric bills and water use.

stories.title: John James: let Michigan towns decide data center rules
stories.dek: U.S. Senate candidate John James told The Detroit News he would leave data-center siting and tax decisions to local officials rather than impose state rules. The stance matters in townships like Saline and Coldwater where residents are already fighting over power use, water draw and tax breaks. Voters in the Aug. 4 primary will see whether the position helps or hurts him in data-center-heavy counties.
stories.source_title: John James says he would let local leaders set data center policy - The Detroit News

stories.title: Dowagiac Campus to Supply 20 Megawatts of AI Compute Under 10-Year Deal
stories.dek: Hyperscale Data will reallocate power at its 415 East Prairie Ronde Street site from Bitcoin mining to a new 20-megawatt AI hosting contract that could generate more than $1.2 billion over the full term, with residents still litigating noise from the facility.

stories.title: Genesee County delays vote on data center environmental clearance
stories.dek: The economic development corporation postponed a key environmental approval for a proposed data center. Flint-area residents now face more uncertainty over traffic, power needs, and industrial noise from the project. The delay gives the public extra weeks to review impacts before any final decision.
stories.source_title: GCEDC appears to delay environmental approval vote for data center - TheDailyNewsOnline.com

stories.title: Otsego bans new data centers for a year
stories.dek: Otsego city council voted to halt all data center proposals for 12 months. Residents near potential sites now have breathing room before any large power or water demands hit local infrastructure. The pause gives the community time to shape rules that protect neighborhoods from noise and grid strain.
stories.source_title: Otsego Council passes 1-year data centers moratorium - hometownsource.com

stories.title: Mason County bids to host Michigan's official state data center
stories.dek: Local leaders are pitching the county as the site for a major state-backed facility that could bring construction jobs and long-term tax revenue. Residents would also face questions about power demand and land use if the project advances. The effort puts a rural western Michigan county in competition with larger metro areas for the economic prize.
stories.source_title: When Mason County pursued Michigan's state data center - shorelinemedia.net

stories.title: Coldwater residents get first look at data center plans at joint meeting
stories.dek: Coldwater City Council and planners will brief the public on proposed data centers. Residents want to know how much power and water the projects would pull and what tax breaks are on the table. The session comes as similar fights heat up in nearby townships.
stories.source_title: Coldwater City Council and Planning Commission to hold joint data center informational meeting - WTVB

stories.title: Verrus pushes ahead on Michigan data center while Salem site stalls
stories.dek: Verrus is moving forward with a Michigan project even as its Salem plans remain uncertain. The company has not disclosed the exact site or size, but local officials are already fielding questions about power demand and tax deals. Michigan communities are watching to see which town lands the next big facility.
stories.source_title: While Salem project is uncertain, Verrus advances data center in Michigan - Salem Reporter

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.

meetings.topic: Data Center Subcommittee Update and zoning ordinance discussion
